versions.subject: Added search(-ms)/WebDAV rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\wscript.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\cmd.exe'
selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: '\DavWWWRoot\'
condition: all of selection_*
